name: Figma
description: Figma is a collaborative interface design platform with a REST API, plugins and OAuth apps for developers.
notes: Project-authored by the Redact Secret project, which maintains this repository; not independent evidence. Candidate credential families were enumerated from the Figma developer documentation pages Authentication, Personal access tokens, Plan access tokens and OAuth apps (recorded as sources under records/sources/developers-figma-com) read on 2026-10-04 by an AI agent run; the list is what those pages name, not a complete inventory. Not reviewed. Scanner-rule artifacts (TruffleHog, Betterleaks, pinned at commits) were read raw only as corroboration for the personal access token format; Gitleaks and Kingfisher were checked: Gitleaks has no Figma rule at the pinned commit, and the Kingfisher rules for Figma are the Betterleaks rules, so they count once. GitHub secret scanning lists Figma personal access token and SCIM token types without a format.
